# Elimix School Management System (SRMS)
> Developed by Mavora Technologies

## Overview
Elimix is a secure, cloud-native, multi-tenant institutional management platform built for primary schools, secondary academies, and tertiary universities. It provides strict database schema partitioning, granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), fee management, and CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum) assessment tracking.

## Core Features
- Strict Multi-Tenant Schema Isolation: Zero cross-tenant data leakage.
- Granular RBAC: Tailored permissions for directors, bursars, teachers, and administrators.
- CBC & Academic Assessment: Real-time rubric tracking and automated report cards.
- Fee Collection & Financial Auditing: Immutable audit trails and term billing.
- Cloud-Native Architecture: Built with Next.js, Node.js/Express, and PostgreSQL.
